messages:
alex chen: FYI I opened a PR that adds an SDK compatibility table + a short note on SLA phrasing for Dedicated provisioning. link: https://git/repo/pulls/5230
meera singh: Thanks. Can we be explicit which fields are removed vs aliased? customers get confused when tenant_affinity silently drops.
pat o'neill: Suggest a small compatibility table: legacy field -> new field -> min SDK version that supports aliasing. Keep it inline in the PR summary.
alex chen: good idea. I'll add the table. proposal: tenant_affinity -> tenant_labels (alias up to SDK 0.9.5), legacy_scale_policy -> autoscale_policy_v1 (alias until 0.10.0).
meera singh: Also add a short note: if SDK < 0.9.3, --apply is a no-op and returns code 0. That tripped a customer last week.
docs-bot: lint: missing cross-link to /handbook/dedicated/migration.md and missing changelog entry. Also flag: add runbook link for rollback.
pat o'neill: I'll paste the rollback command here for the PR so it's obvious:

```bash
# restore previous labels from backup
redwoodctl dedicated restore-tenant --backup backup-2024-06-01.yaml
```

meera singh: add a short smoke-test checklist under the PR, e.g. create temp tenant, migrate with --dry-run, apply, run 60s traffic, check 5xxs and throttle metrics.
qa-bot: queued smoke test: staging -> /handbook/dedicated at 4980012600 by alex chen
alex chen: added smoke checklist and the compatibility table. Also changed SLA sentence from a hard p99 to: "SLA targets are provided as ranges that vary by region and reservation tier."
meera singh: legal ok with that phrasing. ops asked us to avoid the word "outage" and use "transient throttling". quantify: "expected transient throttling under 2 minutes for small pools".
pat o'neill: I've included the isolation note: when labels move, placement on reserved pools may shift causing short rebalances; recommend scheduling migration during low-traffic windows.
alex chen: one more SDK snippet (python) for programmatic migration added to PR: 

```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
resp = c.tenant.migrate('tenant-id', dry_run=True)
print(resp.summary)
# when ready
c.tenant.migrate('tenant-id', apply=True)
```

meera singh: great. once staging smoke test passes, merge and follow with a tiny quickstart fix to bump SDK version notes.
docs-bot: reminder: add changelog entry "docs: dedicated provisioning compatibility table + SLA wording" and tag docs-oncall.
qa-bot: smoke test finished: observed ~40s elevated throttling during label propagation on a 2-node reserved pool, no 5xxs. PASS.
alex chen: merging after CI. thanks everyone :tada:
